legal_units.citation: Section 265 Table, Sl. No. 1
legal_units.title: Return by whom to be verified.
legal_units.text: Person Furnishing Return Of Income: An individual.; To Be Verified: (i) By the individual himself (ii) where the individual is mentally incapacitated from attending to his affairs, by his guardian or any other person competent to act on his behalf (iii) where, for any other reason, it is not possible for the individual to verify the return, by any person duly authorised by him through a valid power of attorney.
